name: Cyber Security Framework in Banks
description: Comprehensive framework mandating banks to put in place an adaptive cybersecurity policy, establish a Cyber Security Operations Centre (C-SOC), and report cyber incidents to RBI.

name: Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices
description: Master Direction prescribing IT governance framework covering IT strategy, risk management, IT controls, business continuity, IT audit, and reporting requirements for regulated entities.

name: Master Direction on Digital Payment Security Controls
description: Prescribes security controls for digital payment channels including internet banking, mobile payments, card payments, and UPI. Covers authentication, encryption, fraud monitoring, and customer protection.

name: IT Framework for the NBFC Sector
description: Detailed IT framework for NBFCs covering IT governance, IT policy, information and cyber security, IT operations, IS audit, business continuity planning, and IT services outsourcing.

name: Comprehensive Cyber Security Framework for Primary (Urban) Cooperative Banks
description: Prescribes a tiered approach to cyber security for UCBs based on their digital depth and interconnectedness. Covers baseline controls, enhanced controls for Level II-IV banks.

name: Guidelines on Managing Risks and Code of Conduct in Outsourcing of Financial Services
description: Guidelines for banks on managing risks associated with outsourcing financial services including IT outsourcing. Covers risk assessment, due diligence, contractual provisions, and monitoring.

name: Tokenisation – Card Transactions: Permitting Card-on-File Tokenisation (CoFT) as a Token Service Provider (TSP)
description: Framework for tokenisation of card transactions extending CoFT facility. Prohibits storage of actual card data by merchants/payment aggregators and mandates tokenization.

name: Storage of Payment System Data – Data Localisation
description: Mandates that all payment system data (full end-to-end transaction details, information collected/carried/processed as part of a payment message) shall be stored only in India.

name: Master Direction on Outsourcing of Information Technology Services
description: Updated Master Direction on outsourcing of IT services covering risk management, governance framework, due diligence requirements, contractual provisions, BCP, and reporting to RBI.

name: Framework for Regulation of Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways
description: Regulatory framework for Payment Aggregators including cybersecurity requirements, PCI-DSS compliance, data security, information security governance, and incident response.

name: Master Direction on Cyber Resilience and Digital Payment Security Controls for Payment System Operators
description: Comprehensive framework for PSOs covering cyber resilience, governance, risk assessment, security operations, incident response, digital payment security controls, and reporting.

name: Reporting of Cyber Security Incidents – Revised Timeline
description: Revised timelines for reporting cyber security incidents to RBI within 6 hours of detection. Prescribes format and classification of incidents.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) for SEBI Regulated Entities
description: Comprehensive CSCRF framework replacing earlier guidelines. Establishes five goals: Anticipate, Withstand, Contain, Recover, and Evolve across all SEBI regulated entities.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework for Stock Exchanges, Clearing Corporations and Depositories
description: Original cybersecurity framework for Market Infrastructure Institutions (MIIs) covering governance, identification, protection, detection, response, and recovery.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Strengthening the Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework for Stockbrokers / Depository Participants
description: Extended cybersecurity framework to stockbrokers and depository participants. Mandates cyber security policy, access controls, network security, data protection, and incident response.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Framework for Adoption of Cloud Services by SEBI Regulated Entities
description: Framework governing cloud adoption by SREs. Covers cloud governance, risk assessment, data classification, vendor due diligence, security controls, and compliance requirements.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: System Audit Framework for Stock Exchanges and Depositories
description: Comprehensive guidelines for system audits covering IT governance, cybersecurity posture, infrastructure, application security, disaster recovery, and business continuity for MIIs.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Technology Risk Management Framework for Mutual Funds / Asset Management Companies
description: Risk management framework for AMCs covering IT governance, cybersecurity, data classification, access management, change management, and third-party risk management.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework for Portfolio Managers
description: Extension of CSCRF framework for portfolio managers. Includes data protection, access controls, incident response, and periodic security assessments.

regulatorFullName: Securities and Exchange Board of India
name: Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) for Stock Exchanges and Depositories
description: Requirements for BCP and DR covering Recovery Time Objective (RTO), Recovery Point Objective (RPO), DR drills, near-site and far-site DR requirements for MIIs.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Guidelines on Information and Cyber Security for Insurers
description: Comprehensive guidelines on information security governance, cybersecurity policy, risk assessment, access controls, data classification, incident management, and business continuity for insurers.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Master Circular on Information and Cyber Security
description: Consolidated master circular on information and cyber security incorporating all previous guidelines. Covers IT governance, cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, and audit.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Guidelines on Outsourcing of Activities by Indian Insurers
description: Guidelines governing outsourcing of activities including IT services. Covers risk assessment, due diligence, contractual safeguards, monitoring, and concentration risk.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Guidelines on Cloud Computing for Insurance Sector
description: Framework for adoption of cloud services by insurance companies covering cloud governance, security controls, data residency, vendor assessment, and compliance requirements.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Corporate Governance Guidelines for Insurers in India
description: Corporate governance framework including IT governance requirements, board oversight of IT risk, information security committee, and technology strategy for insurance companies.

regulatorFullName: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
name: Cyber Incident Reporting Requirements for Insurance Companies
description: Requirements for reporting cyber security incidents to IRDAI including timelines, classification of incidents, and post-incident analysis reporting.

name: UPI Security Assessment Report (SAR) Requirements
description: Mandates Security Assessment Report (SAR) for UPI participating banks and Third Party Application Providers (TPAPs). Covers application security, infrastructure security, and data protection.

name: UPI Data Localisation Requirements
description: Requirements for storage of UPI transaction data within India in compliance with RBI data localization mandate. Covers data storage, processing, and retention requirements.

name: Tokenization Requirements for Card Transactions on NFS Network
description: Operating circular on implementation of card tokenization for NFS ATM transactions in line with RBI's tokenization mandate. Covers token generation, lifecycle management, and security requirements.

name: UPI Security and Risk Mitigation Measures
description: Enhanced security measures for UPI ecosystem including device binding, velocity checks, transaction limits, fraud monitoring, and suspicious transaction reporting requirements.

name: PPI Interoperability Security Requirements
description: Security requirements for Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI) operating on UPI rails. Covers KYC verification, transaction security, and interoperability compliance.

name: AePS Security and Fraud Management Guidelines
description: Security guidelines for Aadhaar-enabled Payment System covering biometric authentication security, agent due diligence, fraud prevention controls, and transaction monitoring.

name: IMPS Security and Risk Compliance Requirements
description: Security requirements for IMPS (Immediate Payment Service) participants covering authentication protocols, encryption standards, velocity checks, and reconciliation.

name: Cyber Security and Data Protection Framework for NPCI Member Institutions
description: Comprehensive cyber security framework for all NPCI member institutions covering governance, risk assessment, security operations, incident response, and periodic compliance assessments.

name: Aadhaar Data Vault Guidelines
description: Mandates use of Aadhaar Data Vault for secure storage of Aadhaar numbers. Requires reference key mapping, encryption at rest, access controls, and audit logging.

name: Virtual ID (VID) Implementation Guidelines
description: Introduction of Virtual ID as an alternative to Aadhaar number for authentication. Covers VID generation, usage, revocation, and limited KYC implementation requirements.

name: Security Requirements for Authentication User Agencies (AUA) and KYC User Agencies (KUA)
description: Comprehensive security requirements for AUA/KUA agencies covering infrastructure security, application security, biometric device security, key management, and audit requirements.

name: Security Audit Requirements for Aadhaar Authentication Ecosystem
description: Mandates periodic information security audits for all entities in the Aadhaar authentication ecosystem. Specifies audit scope, frequency, auditor qualifications, and reporting requirements.

name: Guidelines on Use of Face Authentication and Iris Authentication
description: Guidelines for implementing face and iris authentication modalities. Covers device specifications, liveness detection, image quality requirements, and anti-spoofing measures.

name: Aadhaar e-KYC API Security and Compliance Requirements
description: Security and compliance requirements for e-KYC API integration covering encrypted communication, digital signatures, session management, API key management, and data handling.

name: Information Security Policy for Aadhaar Enrolment Centres
description: Information security policy for Aadhaar enrolment centres covering physical security, personnel security, device security, data protection during enrolment, and incident handling.
